messages:
maria_sales: Kicked off Aurora Health POC load probe. Need runbook + cost estimate for 1000 qps sustained with 2k peak microbursts.
sam.lewis: Thanks — I'll sketch a runbook. TL;DR: steady 1k qps for 10m, 2k qps bursts 30s x6, measure p50/p95/p99 and tail (99.9). Keep seq len at 256.
kevin_eng: Also include KV cache enabled (prefix cache) and batching sizes. We'll test with small and large batch config.
anya_se: customer asked about encryption in transit + KMS for logs. They need an encrypted audit trail and key residency in their EU KMS.
sam.lewis: For load: we'll run wrk2 + custom client that hits chat stream and embed endpoints. Command example:
```bash
wrk -t12 -c400 -d600s -R1000 --latency http://redwood-proxy/prod/compose
```
maria_sales: Nice. What's the expected token burn per request? they'll price against per-token hosted and reserved capacity.
kevin_eng: Estimate ~120 tokens/request average -> ~120k tokens/s at 1k qps = 432M tokens/hour. Add overhead for RPC.
anya_se: On KMS/key residency: we can offer private deployment in their EU region (customer-managed keys). I'll flag SSO + SOC2 notes in questionnaire.
eng_ops_bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment to prod-proxy with request-shadowing enabled completed at 1748457790.
sam.lewis: Measurement plan: record latency histograms from client + server traces. Use tracing tag redwood.poc=aurora. Save samples to s3://redwood-poc/aurora/1748457777.
kevin_eng: We should also test with quantized model variant to lower GPU costs for per-token math. Run a second sweep: quantized-low, full-fp.
maria_sales: How long to get results? can we present a heatmap for next-day call?
sam.lewis: Yes — run tonight (10m steady + bursts x6) should finish ~2h including aggregation. I'll push plots: p50/p95/p99, token/sec, GPU util, and heatmap of tail by QPS.
anya_se: Also confirm they need encryption at rest for logs — add to questionnaire reply.
maria_sales: ok please include cost ballpark for hosted vs dedicated for the observed throughput. also add notes on fallbacks (smaller model if capacity hits).
sam.lewis: Will include: cost per million tokens, reserved capacity commit estimate, and burst pricing assumptions. Also note model-fallback policy we can enable.
kevin_eng: Quick checklist for run:
- ensure prefix cache on
- batch size sweep: [1,4,8]
- sequence length 256
- run quantized variant
- collect GPU and NV stats
- record full latency histograms
maria_sales: :thumbsup: thanks team — pls upload results to the thread once done, i'll share with Aurora stakeholders.
sam.lewis: Will post plots + run logs here when ready.
maria_sales: tagging @anya_se for the security questionnaire follow-up.
anya_se: Got it, I'll draft the KMS/retention answers and share before the handoff.
eng_ops_bot: incident-bot: No incidents recorded during the run window.
kevin_eng: One more note — watch for tail jitter on microbursts, might need to tune autoscale cooldowns.
sam.lewis: Good call. I'll include recommended autoscale cooldown 45s and burst buffer of 2x baseline.
maria_sales: Great. Meeting prep: next-day 11:00 CET demo. I'll prep one-slide summary + link to full runbook.
